validate_release_notes: validate that release notes match the manifest exactly by checking for missing and extra PR numbers
run_validate_cli: run the release notes validation CLI with --version and --json flags to check PR completeness
extract_pr_references: extract all PR numbers referenced in markdown release notes content
load_manifest: load expected PR numbers from the manifest.json file in the release notes output directory
find_release_notes_file: find the most recent or version-specific release notes markdown file
